newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Ceausescu heir in hospital, seriously ill.
newsitem.headline: Ceausescu heir in hospital, seriously ill.

text.p: BUCHAREST, Sept 16 (reuter) - Nicu Ceausescu, youngest son of Romania's late Stalinist dictator is in a Bucharest hospital with a serious liver condition, hospital officials said on Monday.
Doctors would decide whether Ceausescu required a liver transplant. They described his condition as serious, with internal bleeding, one official said.
"Nicu was hospitalised late on Sunday with haemorrhage, chronic liver cirrhosis and a varicose oesophagus," she said.

Ceausescu, 45, groomed as the dictator's successor, served three years in jail on charges linked to the repression of protests in his fiefdom of Sibiu during the December 1989 revolt in which his father was ousted and shot by firing squad.
He was paroled on health grounds in 1992.
"His condition is grave and doctors will have to decide if he can be taken to a hospital abroad," the official said.
Doctors and Ceausescu's relatives were not immediately available for comment.
